rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-white
rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-zinc-100

typography.special: South Indian language text (Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada) must be rendered prominently using Noto Sans fallback for high legibility and premium cultural feel.

cards.base: bg-zinc-900/50 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6

buttons.primary: bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-semibold shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(229,9,20,0.4)] transition-all flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: bg-white/5 hover:bg-white/10 text-white border border-white/10 rounded-lg px-6 py-3 font-medium backdrop-blur-md transition-all
buttons.ghost: text-zinc-400 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-all

inputs.base: bg-black/50 border border-white/10 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-purple-500 focus:border-transparent placeholder-zinc-600 transition-all

ui_components.glass_header: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/5

animations.page_transitions: Fade in with slight upward Y-axis translation
animations.hover_effects: Smooth easing, soft glowing dropshadows, tracing beam borders for premium feel
animations.processing: Cinematic loading animations (e.g., sound-wave bars, glowing pulses) to represent AI dubbing progress

icons.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a sophisticated, sleek look

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='upload-movie-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Left-sidebar dashboard structure using the 'Dark charcoal' and 'Matte black' theme.
Do NOT use standard white/light generic SaaS UI. This must feel like a premium OTT platform.
Implement Drag-and-Drop using Shadcn/Custom UI with soft glowing borders on hover.
Integrate Framer Motion for dashboard widget rendering and AI processing stage transitions.
Ensure the Google OAuth login page has a cinematic background (use hero_abstract_bg with heavy dark overlay).
Use Outfit font for big cinematic titles and Manrope for UI data/labels.
Never center everything; use asymmetric layouts and generous padding (p-6, p-8) to give a luxurious feel.
